mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sales_order (customer_id, item_id, org_unit_id, employee_id, quantity, unit_price, amount, status) VALUES (#{customerId}, #{itemId}, #{orgUnitId}, #{employeeId}, #{quantity}, #{unitPrice}, #{amount}, #{status})
mapper.sql: SELECT s.id, s.customer_id, s.item_id, s.org_unit_id, s.employee_id, s.quantity, s.unit_price, s.amount, s.status, s.created_at, s.confirmed_at, c.name AS customer_name, i.name AS item_name, i.unit AS item_unit, o.name AS org_unit_name FROM sales_order s JOIN customer c ON c.id = s.customer_id JOIN item i ON i.id = s.item_id JOIN org_unit o ON o.id = s.org_unit_id
mapper.select: WHERE s.employee_id = #{employeeId} ORDER BY s.created_at DESC, s.id DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE sales_order SET status = 'CONFIRMED', confirmed_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT o.name AS org_unit_name, DATE_FORMAT(s.confirmed_at, '%Y-%m') AS sales_ym, SUM(s.amount) AS total_amount FROM sales_order s JOIN org_unit o ON o.id = s.org_unit_id WHERE s.status = 'CONFIRMED' GROUP BY s.org_unit_id, DATE_FORMAT(s.confirmed_at, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY sales_ym DESC, org_unit_name
